name: go9_se_globalpool
hypothesis: SE blocks (channel attention) + global pooling in value head + 6 res blocks gives better feature quality and spatial awareness. KataGo and Leela Zero both use SE blocks.
success_criteria: >60% vs random by iter 100, loss monotonically decreasing. Compare to scale500 at same iteration count.
notes: From scratch (different architecture than Fix D). 200 iters, 100 games/iter (tuned). 1.88M params, SE blocks + deeper net.
summary: 200 iters completed. Loss 4.92→1.389 (best). BEST LOSS of all experiments: 1.389 vs fresh_correct 1.639 vs scale500 1.605. SE blocks + global pool + 6 res blocks clearly better architecture. 204.9m on A5000 (Xeon E5-2699). Iter time 45-66s (slower than 4-block CNN due to larger model + window buffer growth). vsRandom not tested during training.
